message: The other day, I found myself in a classic showdown with my grandkids over storm prep. They were busy building a fort out of pillows, convinced it would protect them from anything Mother Nature could throw at us. I had to chuckle; while they were crafting their cozy fortress, I was trying to convince them that maybe we should also gather some snacks and flashlights, just in case. It’s funny how their idea of readiness involves a soft landing, while mine is a bit more... practical. Maybe a little balance is the key? 🏰
